- **TCCC** ✔: APL-ND (no derivatives); v0.0.9 WIP; game 1.7.0.49.
- **Server-restricted content** ✔: Slavic War items (made for / only on SW servers); TLC content needs TLC permission.
- **Deep chains** ✔: Minnesinger X ATAK Compat → Zeliks Character, Kova x ATAK, Minnesinger Gear, ATAK x COMPAT. Minnesinger Gear needs a separate RHS compat.
- **Collections**: Minnesinger Mods Collection is another server's (CIE) bundle — rejected by policy in favor of modules.
